_readme: Hand-scored ground truth for Phase 6's two measured acceptance gates. Committed so a
regression is visible per fixture rather than only in a total.
GATE 1 — OCR. Each fixture carries the strings a DJ would need to identify the record:
one artist slot and one slot per title. A slot is null when the spike's run could not
read it at all; a null slot is never recoverable and never counts as found. Each string
is the SHORTEST DISTINCTIVE FORM of that element, not the full catalogue title — the
second title of IMG_0498 is 'Fuck Willie Brown (Dom & Roland Remix)' and its distinctive
recoverable token is 'Brown'. Verdict: clean = every slot found, fail = none found,
partial = between. Matching is approximate-substring, one edit per four characters, over
the alphanumeric concatenation of ALL returned observations at every confidence — which
is how the spike itself scored, and why untrusted reads are in scope here but not in the
This is a REGRESSION gate against research/OCR-SPIKE.md's measured 6 clean / 5 partial /
1 fail. It is not a measure of absolute accuracy against a discography.
GATE 2 — segmentation. 'tracks' is the number of playable tracks on the record, scored by
hand from the photographs. Segmentation runs on the TRUSTED tier only (SEG-08). A fixture
is 'usable' when the segmenter returns exactly this count.
